# Data import 

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
# CONFIGURATION --------------- 
library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)

base_dir <- "/work/williarj/williarj/2627_HJH_Thesis/"

# Test directory 
list.dirs(base_dir, full.names = FALSE, recursive = FALSE)

data <- data.frame()
data4 <- read.csv(paste0(base_dir, "data/outputs/aim2_onlygen3/experiment_4.csv"))
data5 <- read.csv(paste0(base_dir, "data/outputs/aim2_onlygen3/experiment_5.csv"))
data6 <- read.csv(paste0(base_dir, "data/outputs/aim2_onlygen3/experiment_6.csv"))
data <- rbind(data, data4)
data <- rbind(data, data5)
data <- rbind(data, data6)
```

# Data manipulation

```{r}
# 1. Rename Q values 
data <- data %>% rename(q_value_pop2 = q_value_pop2_JC)
data <- data %>% rename(q_value_pop1 = q_value_pop1_JA)
data <- data %>% select(-q_value_pop2) # remove, and then decide if we need to 1-pop or now 

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    hybrid_status = case_when(
      str_detect(ind_id, "IND") ~ str_split_i(ind_id, "_", 2),
      str_detect(ind_id, "F1") ~ "F1",
      str_detect(ind_id, "F2") ~ "F2",
      str_detect(ind_id, "B2POP1") ~ "B2POP1",
      str_detect(ind_id, "B2POP2") ~ "B2POP2",
      str_detect(ind_id, "B3POP1") ~ "B3POP1",
      str_detect(ind_id, "B3POP2") ~ "B3POP2"
    )
  )

# JC_orientation means pop1 == JC? -- doesn't necessary align with the BC2POP1 labels
data <- data %>%
  group_by(experiment_ID, bootstrap_ID, run_id) %>%
  mutate(
    JC_orientation = mean(
      q_value_pop1[hybrid_status == "JC"],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) > 0.5,
    
    JC = if_else(
      JC_orientation,
      q_value_pop1,
      1 - q_value_pop1
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Correct labels 
data <- data %>% mutate(
    hybrid_status = case_when(
      # Known pure individuals
      str_detect(ind_id, "_JC$") ~ "JC",
      str_detect(ind_id, "_JA$") ~ "JA",
      
      # F1 / F2
      str_detect(ind_id, "F1") ~ "F1",
      str_detect(ind_id, "F2") ~ "F2",
      
      # B2
      # JC_orientation = True, means that pop2=JC, pop1=JA
      str_detect(ind_id, "B2POP1") & JC_orientation ~ "B2_JA",
      str_detect(ind_id, "B2POP2") & JC_orientation ~ "B2_JC",
      str_detect(ind_id, "B2POP1") & !JC_orientation ~ "B2_JA",
      str_detect(ind_id, "B2POP2") & !JC_orientation ~ "B2_JC",
      
      # B3
      str_detect(ind_id, "B3POP1") & JC_orientation ~ "B3_JA",
      str_detect(ind_id, "B3POP2") & JC_orientation ~ "B3_JC",
      str_detect(ind_id, "B3POP1") & !JC_orientation ~ "B3_JA",
      str_detect(ind_id, "B3POP2") & !JC_orientation ~ "B3_JC",
      
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
)
```

# Cateogrical 
```{r}
# Factor order of the data/categorical variables 
data <- data %>%
  mutate(hybrid_status = factor(
    hybrid_status,
    levels = c("JA","B3_JA", "B2_JA", "F1", "F2", "B2_JC", "B3_JC", "JC")
  ))

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    experiment_ID = factor(
      experiment_ID,
      levels = c(4, 5, 6),
      labels = c("500_loci", "1000_loci", "5000_loci")
    )
  )

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    bootstrap_ID = factor(bootstrap_ID)
  )

```

# Box plot - everything 

```{r}
q_dist_plot <- ggplot(data, aes(experiment_ID, y = JC, fill = experiment_ID)) +
  # Draw boxplot to show median and IQR per experiment
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA) +
  # Overlay actual individual observations cleanly on top
  # geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.3) +
  # Separate panels by hybrid class
  facet_wrap(~ hybrid_status, ncol=8) +
  # Corrected Labels
  labs(
    title = "Comparison of q-values across different loci",
    x = "Experiment ID", # Fixed axis label to match data
    y = "Q-value (1-JC, 0-JA)"
  ) +
  # scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.05, 1.05), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    #legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(q_dist_plot)
```

# Bar plot - everything 

```{r}
# Combine both grouping variables inside a single group_by statement
summary_data_2 <- data %>%
  group_by(experiment_ID, hybrid_status) %>%
  summarize(
    # mean_q_JA  = mean(JA, na.rm = TRUE),
    # sd_q_JA    = sd(JA, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_q_JC  = mean(JC, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_q_JC    = sd(JC, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_runs = n(),
    .groups    = "drop" # This automatically ungroups the data after summarizing
  )

print(summary_data_2)

summary_data_2 <- summary_data_2 %>% filter(!hybrid_status %in% c("JC", "JA"))
q_dist_plot <- ggplot(summary_data_2, 
                      aes(x = experiment_ID, y = sd_q_JC, fill = experiment_ID)) +
  
  # Bar chart
  geom_col(alpha = 0.6) +
  
  # Set y-axis limits
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.1)) +
  
  # Separate panels by hybrid class
  facet_wrap(~ hybrid_status, ncol = 8) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Comparison of q-value stds across different loci estimates",
    x = "Experiment ID",
    y = "Standard deviation of Q-value"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(q_dist_plot)

```

# Bar plot - across bootstraps

```{r}
summary_bootstrap <- data %>%
  group_by(experiment_ID, bootstrap_ID, hybrid_status) %>%
  summarize(
    # mean_q_JA  = mean(JA, na.rm = TRUE),
    # sd_q_JA    = sd(JA, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_q_JC  = mean(JC, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_q_JC    = sd(JC, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_runs = n(),
    .groups    = "drop" # This automatically ungroups the data after summarizing
  )

print(summary_bootstrap)
```

```{r}
# ---------------------
# No JC/JA
#summary_bootstrap <- summary_bootstrap %>% filter(!hybrid_status %in% c("JC", "JA"))
#summary_bootstrap <- summary_bootstrap %>% filter(!hybrid_status %in% c("F1", "F2"))
q_dist_plot_all <- ggplot(summary_bootstrap, 
                      aes(x = bootstrap_ID, y = sd_q_JC, fill = bootstrap_ID)) +
  # Bar chart
  geom_col(alpha = 0.6) +
  
  # Set y-axis limits
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.1)) +
  
  # Separate panels by experiment (rows) and hybrid status (columns)
  facet_grid(experiment_ID ~ hybrid_status) + 
  
  labs(
    title = "Bootstraps of q-value stds across different loci #s",
    x = "Bootstrap #",
    y = "Standard deviation of Q-value"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(q_dist_plot_all)

```

# Density plot 

```{r}
data_zoom_in <- data %>% filter(JC > 0.75) %>% filter(experiment_ID == "5000_loci")
#data_zoom_in <- data %>% filter(hybrid_status %in% c("JA", "F1", "B1_JC", "B2_JC", "B3_JC", "JC"))

q_density_plot <- ggplot(data_zoom_in, 
                         aes(x = JC, fill = hybrid_status, color = hybrid_status)) +
  geom_density(aes(y = after_stat(ndensity)), alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ experiment_ID, ncol = 3) +
  #scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.75, 1), breaks = seq(0.75, 1, by = 0.05)) +
  labs(
    title = "Density Distribution of Q-values Across Experiments",
    x = "Q-value (1 = JC, 0 = JA)",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Hybrid_status",
    color = "Hybrid_status"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(q_density_plot)
```
